0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets, now 2-6 and 13th in the East, visit the Atlanta Hawks, who are 5-4, first in the Southeast, and on a two-game winning streak, in the Nets' ninth game of the season. Brooklyn is 1-3 on the road and is missing Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Noah Clowney (day-to-day, knee soreness, game-time decision), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The two teams have no games yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
